g.text: GALINI / L03 / shared occupancy and open wells
Critical floor/ceiling relationships / actual plan voids are H-L, H-P and H-S
Laundry House / Lower undercroft / upper frontage
Lower +0, upper +4; slab .30 m, clear under slab 3.70 m. Stair void remains open over both
flights and the +2 landing. The dashed stair is an unfolded relationship; exact plan turns and
well polygon govern.
The floor and stairwell are separate shapes. Do not close the well with a generic upper slab or
count a scenic roof as an occupied level.
Press stair house / Lower vestibule / upper A-facing passage
Lower +4, upper +8; slab .30 m, clear under slab 3.70 m. Stair void remains open over both
flights and the +6 landing. The dashed stair is an unfolded relationship; exact plan turns and
well polygon govern.
The floor and stairwell are separate shapes. Do not close the well with a generic upper slab or
count a scenic roof as an occupied level.
School / Lower arcade at y82–86 is north of the well
Lower +4, upper +8; slab .30 m, clear under slab 3.70 m. Stair void remains open over both
flights and the +6 landing. The dashed stair is an unfolded relationship; exact plan turns and
well polygon govern.
School: the actual through-arcade is y82–86, beyond the stair landing ending at y81. The upper
floor continues over that arcade; the +6 landing does not form its ceiling.
Coordinate plans and door IDs resolve the route: Laundry D01→D02→S1→D03/D04; Press D07→S4→D08; School D16→S7→D19/D20/D23, with separate lower through-arcade D17→D18. These are
design sections, not compiled clearance acceptance.
